content: Golgi-associated PDZ and coiled-coil motif-containing protein (GOPC) is a protein encoded by the GOPC gene in humans. PIST, another name for GOPC, is a Golgi protein that contains a PDZ domain. PDZ domains are structural motifs composed of approximately 90 amino acids. These domains specifically bind to the extreme C-terminal regions of target proteins in a sequence-dependent manner. GOPC has been demonstrated to interact with several proteins, including glutamate receptor delta-2 subunit (GRID2), Beclin-1 (BECN1), Ras homolog family member Q (RHOQ), acid-sensing ion channel 3 (ACCN3), cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR), and chondroitin sulfate proteoglycan 5 (CSPG5).
